verdict.rationale: Expensify's own Integration Server API is documented for programmatically downloading expense report data and can act on behalf of users via OAuth2, so an agent can at least pull expense data. Nothing shows the API or an MCP server can filter for uncoded transactions or write categories, tags or policy flags back for review. The in-app 'Ask Expensify' assistant and native auto-categorization are Expensify's own features, not an external agent's API/MCP workflow, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: MCP server, API filtering for uncoded transactions, API write-back of categories/tags/GL coding, API-surfaced policy flags, a review queue for agent-proposed coding, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull uncoded transactions via API or MCP, propose categorizations and policy flags, and push clean coding back for review
